name: Throwback PORTO Party
description: Get nostalgic at the Tram Museum with a massive party dedicated to the biggest hits of the 80s, 90s, and 2000s.
longDescription:
The Throwback PORTO Party is a nightlife event dedicated to music from the 1980s, 1990s, and 2000s. This event brings together a selection of popular tracks from these three decades, offering an evening focused on popular music from a specific era. The organizers aim to create an atmosphere centered around well-known songs from these periods.

Attendees can expect an evening of dancing within the unique setting of the Museu do Carro Eléctrico. The event is designed for an adult audience interested in pop, rock, and dance music from the specified decades. The historic building of the Tram Museum provides a distinctive backdrop for the party.

Tickets are required for entry. The Museu do Carro Eléctrico is located on Alameda Basílio Teles and can be reached by tram line 1 (Infante stop) or bus lines 500, 504, 507, 601, 602, and 902.
